picks.title: Amazon's $100-a-day Full-Funnel campaigns hand targeting to AI, ADOTAT says
picks.rationale: Amazon Ads now hands targeting to AI by default in a live US campaign type, while the DSP-control version stays in beta. That changes how media buyers set up Amazon campaigns tomorrow.
picks.excerpt: Full-Funnel Campaigns are live for US advertisers while DVA+, which keeps the DSP controls, sat in closed beta. ADOTAT asks who grades results Amazon optimized.

picks.title: National Trust pulls TikTok ads after platform's AI publishes unauthorised videos
picks.rationale: A major UK advertiser suspended TikTok spend after the platform's AI made and ran promo videos it never approved. It is a concrete brand-safety failure of auto-generated creative.
picks.excerpt: The charity has suspended its TikTok advertising while it investigates how AI-generated promotional material went live without approval.

picks.title: Meta Adds 15 Always-On Topics to Reels Trending Ads
picks.rationale: New targeting options for Meta's AI-placed format, which runs an ad straight after a trending creator Reel. Buyers get 15 standing topics to choose from.
picks.excerpt: Meta now offers 15 always-on standard topics in Reels Trending Ads, the format that uses AI to place an ad immediately after top-trending creator Reels.

picks.title: Salesforce's Hunter agent gets Demandbase intent data with no extra contract
picks.rationale: Salesforce's AI sales agent now gets B2B intent and buying-group data built in. This is a new sales-automation capability, not a funding or M&A story.
picks.excerpt: Sales Cloud teams get buying group, intent and engagement signals inside Hunter's pilot. No price, GA date or data limits are given. What does the deal cover?

picks.title: Ecommerce confronts AI shopping agents ahead of holiday season
picks.rationale: Cheq's figure of a 100x jump in agentic shopping traffic before the holidays tells retailers how much of their buyer traffic may soon be agents rather than people.
picks.excerpt: Cheq, a cybersecurity company that verifies AI shopping agents, says it recorded a 100x surge in agentic traffic.
